operations.name: invoices.add
operations.description: Add a receipt or invoice like the Add Invoice form: a one-time bill dated today, optionally with its PDF; logs 'Invoice Added' in the feed.

vendor.description: Merchant / vendor name. Required unless pdf_filename names a known vendor (AWS, OpenAI, Cursor, Figma, Vercel, Stripe, Google).

currency.description: Currency code (default: the workspace's currency, as the form opens on it).

invoice_number.description: Invoice / reference number. Default: taken from pdf_filename (INV-, REC- or BILL-), else INV-<6 digits>.

pdf_filename.description: Name of the attached PDF (must end in .pdf); goes with pdf_base64.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF file as base64 (e.g. @file.b64); stored on the invoice. Needs pdf_filename.

group.description: Workspace id or exact name, or 'all' to file it under no workspace (as the app does under All Workspaces). Default: the workspace the app opens on (the newest one).

operations.name: invoices.delete
operations.description: Delete an invoice or receipt; also logs 'Invoice Removed' in the feed.

operations.name: subscriptions.add
operations.description: Add a recurring subscription like the Add Subscription form; also logs 'New Subscription' in the feed.

currency.description: Currency code (default: the workspace's currency, as the form opens on it).

next_renewal_date.description: Next renewal date, YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days from now).

group.description: Workspace id or exact name, or 'all' to file it under no workspace (as the app does under All Workspaces). Default: the workspace the app opens on (the newest one).

operations.name: subscriptions.set-status
operations.description: Pause or re-activate a subscription (the Pause / Activate buttons).

status.description: paused to pause, active to activate.

operations.name: subscriptions.delete
operations.description: Delete a subscription; also logs 'Subscription Removed' in the feed.

operations.name: groups.add
operations.description: Create a workspace like the Create New Workspace form: name, description, one of the six theme colors and a default currency.

operations.name: groups.update
operations.description: Change a workspace's name, description, theme color or default currency (the Edit form and the header currency switch).

operations.name: groups.delete
operations.description: Delete a workspace (refused for the last one) together with its invoices, subscriptions and feed rows.
